title: v1.5.0 - Apple UI Spring Filters, Student Directory Filtering & System Resilience

notes.en: Official release v1.5.0: Introduces Apple-style spring animations on all filter controls and pill bars; comprehensive animated filtering & sorting on Student pages (Status, Grade, Courses, Presets); dark-mode splash screen integration; and multi-device base system resilience.
